thread:
Eve: quick PSA: autogenerated models are typing lists of optional objects as List[Optional[Any]] in the latest SDK build. Editors show no completions for .items() etc. Repro in sample-app attached.

Eve: minimal repro:
```py
resp = client.list_orders()
for o in resp.orders:
    # o.shipping -> Any
    print(o.shipping.zip)
```

Jon: ugh, is that coming from codegen emitting `list` instead of `List[Order]`? or are we losing generics after our transport wrapper?

Priya: looked at generated models:
```py
class OrdersResponse(BaseModel):
    orders: Optional[list] = None
```
So it's the generator defaulting to bare list. Pyright collapses that to List[Any].

Lucas: this is different than the enum/union bug we fixed last month but similarly bad DX. Two short-term mitigations: 1) Add typed pyi stubs for public endpoints. 2) Add runtime attribute `__annotations__` preservation in our async wrapper to keep signatures for tools that introspect.

Eve: 1 sounds doable. 2 may be brittle across Python versions. Also consider emitting TypedDict for freeform objects instead of bare dict/list. TypedDict helps static checkers a lot for user-facing shapes.

Jon: suggestion for generator heuristics:
- if schema.type == 'array' and items has $ref -> emit List[RefType]
- if schema.type == 'array' and items is object with properties -> emit List[GeneratedModel]
- fallback: List[Json] with Json TypeAlias (recursive)

Priya: we should prefer Pydantic BaseModel for objects with properties and TypedDict for additionalProperties-only schemas. TypedDict is friendlier for downstream consumers who just want keys.

Lucas: FYI infra ran a quick pyright run against samples and found ~12 affected lines. InfraBot logged: https://ci.redwood.dev/pyright/runs/8842

Priya: small implementation plan: I can add Json = Union[str,int,float,bool,None,Dict[str, "Json"], List["Json"]] and export it from models.__init__ so stubs can reuse it. Then change generator to emit List[Json] and Dict[str, Json] for freeform cases.

Eve: can someone take the pyi stub for list_orders while the generator patch lands? It's low-risk and will help folks using the hosted SDK right now.

Jon: I'll draft the pyi under redwood/types/clients.pyi and add a pyright test to CI. It will map list_orders -> List[OrderModel] | None.

Priya: also let's add a changelog bullet: "Fix: improved typing for arrays and freeform objects (pyright/mypy)" and note that consumers should upgrade to the new micro release.

Eve: one more edge case: async iterator endpoints (streaming) are annotated as AsyncIterator[Any]. We should make the stream yield typed models (AsyncIterator[OrderEvent]). Otherwise sample apps that `async for ev in client.stream_orders()` get zero help.

Lucas: yep add that to the generator matrix.

InfraBot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/712 titled "generator: emit typed collections and Json alias for better mypy/pyright support" assigned to Priya, Jon.

Eve: thanks all. I'll update sample-app README to recommend pinning to the stubbed SDK until the micro release is out.
